blocks.text: to + fe'l yoki predlog + -ing: ma'no o'zgaradi

Ba'zi sifatlardan keyin ham **to + fe'l**, ham **predlog + -ing** kelishi mumkin — lekin ma'no har xil. Bu darsda to'rtta juftlik: **afraid to / afraid of -ing**, **sorry to / sorry for (about) -ing**, **interested to / interested in -ing**, **sure to / sure of -ing**. Sifat + predlog asoslari qizil kitobda (→ qizil kitob, 112-dars), predlog + -ing — 60-darsda. Umumiy mantiq: **to** — ko'pincha ataylab qilinadigan (yoki qilinmaydigan) harakat yoki shu ondagi reaksiya; **predlog + -ing** — kutilmagan hodisa, umumiy holat yoki o'tgan ish.
afraid to do va afraid of doing

**afraid to do** — biror ishni **qilishga qo'rqmoq**: uning yomon oqibati bo'lishi mumkin, shuning uchun siz **ataylab qilmaslikni tanlaysiz**. She was **afraid to tell** her parents — Ota-onasiga **aytishga qo'rqdi** (va aytmadi). **afraid of doing** — biror yomon narsa **sodir bo'lib qolishidan** qo'rqmoq; bu sizning ixtiyoringizda emas, tasodifan bo'ladi. I'm **afraid of falling** — **Yiqilib tushishdan** qo'rqaman (yiqilishni hech kim ataylab qilmaydi). Shuning uchun: We walked slowly because we were **afraid of slipping** — «afraid to slip» deyilmaydi. Ba'zan ikkalasi ham to'g'ri: I'm **afraid to fly** / I'm **afraid of flying**.

headers: afraid to do — qilishga jur'at etmaslik
rows: I was **afraid to ask** the teacher a question.
I was **afraid of looking** stupid in front of the class.
Many people are **afraid to go** out alone at night.
The boy is **afraid to touch** the dog.

items.text: Jasur was **afraid to complain** because he didn't want to lose his job.
items.translation: Jasur ishidan ayrilishni istamagani uchun **shikoyat qilishga qo'rqdi**.

items.text: I always check the door twice — I'm **afraid of forgetting** to lock it.
items.translation: Eshikni doim ikki marta tekshiraman — **qulflashni unutib qo'yishdan qo'rqaman**.

items.text: Don't be **afraid to ask** for help if you need it.

blocks.text: **I'm afraid (that) ...** — mutlaqo boshqa ibora: muloyimlik bilan yoqimsiz xabar berish, «afsuski»: **I'm afraid** we're fully booked tonight — **Afsuski**, bugun bo'sh xonamiz yo'q. Bu yerda qo'rquv yo'q.
sorry to do va sorry for / about doing

**sorry to + fe'l** — shu ondagi holat uchun afsus yoki uzr: **sorry to hear** (eshitib achindim), **sorry to bother / disturb / interrupt you** (hozir bezovta qilyapman, uzr), **sorry to say** (afsus bilan aytaman), **sorry to leave** (ketish og'ir). **sorry for / about + -ing** — **ilgari qilgan ishingiz** uchun uzr: I'm **sorry for shouting** at you yesterday. Bu ma'noda **I'm sorry I + o'tgan zamon** ham juda tabiiy: I'm **sorry I shouted**. Rasmiyroq: I'm sorry **to have kept** you waiting. Kishiga achinish — **feel sorry for** + ot: I **feel sorry for** him.

rows: **Sorry to bother** you, but can I ask a quick question?
**Sorry for bothering** you yesterday — I was in a panic.
I was **sorry to hear** about your accident.
I'm **sorry to say** that the project has been cancelled.

items.text: **Sorry to interrupt**, but there's a phone call for you.
items.translation: **Gapingizni bo'lganim uchun kechirasiz**, sizga qo'ng'iroq bor.

items.text: I'm really **sorry for being** so rude at yesterday's meeting.
items.translation: Kechagi yig'ilishda **qo'pollik qilganim uchun** chin dildan **uzr so'rayman**.

items.text: We were **sorry to hear** that you're leaving the company.

blocks.text: interested in doing va interested to hear

**interested in doing** — biror ishga qiziqish, uni qilish niyati yoki xohishi: I'm **interested in learning** Japanese — Yapon tilini **o'rganishga qiziqaman** (o'rganmoqchiman). **interested to + hear / see / know / read / learn / find out** — biror ma'lumotni **bilganda** (yoki bilsa) paydo bo'ladigan qiziqish: I was **interested to read** that ... — ...ni **o'qib, qiziqib qoldim**; I'd be **interested to know** what you think — Fikringizni **bilish qiziq bo'lardi**. Ya'ni **in -ing** — umumiy qiziqish yoki kelajakdagi ish; **to** — ma'lumotga reaksiya.

items.text: Are you **interested in joining** our book club?
I was **interested to learn** that Tom speaks a little Uzbek.
items.translation: Tom ozgina o'zbekcha gapirishini **bilib, qiziqib qoldim**.

blocks.text: sure to do va sure of doing

**sure / certain to do** — **gapiruvchi** amin: Aziz **is sure to win** — (Men aminman) Aziz albatta yutadi (→ 65-dars). **sure / certain of doing** (yoki **sure that ...**) — **egasining o'zi** amin: Aziz **is sure of winning** — Aziz o'zi yutishiga amin (balki u xato qilayotgandir). **confident of doing** ham shunday — egasining ishonchi.

items.text: Kate **is sure to get** the job — she's the best candidate.
items.translation: Keyt **albatta** ishga **olinadi** — u eng yaxshi nomzod.

items.text: Kate **is sure of getting** the job, but I'm not so certain.
items.translation: Keyt ishga **olinishiga o'zi amin**, lekin men unchalik ishonmayman.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: (1) tasodifiy hodisa bilan afraid to: «I'm afraid to lose my keys» → I'm **afraid of losing** my keys. (2) «I'm afraid of to go» → afraid **to go** / afraid **of going**. (3) o'tgan ish uchun sorry to: «Sorry to be late yesterday» → **Sorry for being** late / **Sorry I was** late yesterday. (4) «I'm interesting in» → I'm **interested in** (interesting — narsa haqida, → 98-dars). (5) niyat ma'nosida «I'm interested to learn Japanese» → interested **in learning** Japanese.

Eslab qolish: **to** — siz tanlaysiz yoki bu hozir sodir bo'lyapti (aytishga qo'rqaman, bezovta qilyapman, eshitib achindim). **of / for / in + -ing** — siz boshqara olmaydigan hodisa, o'tgan ish yoki umumiy qiziqish (yiqilishdan qo'rqaman, baqirganim uchun uzr, o'rganishga qiziqaman).

rows: hozirgi holat: sorry **to bother** you, sorry **to hear**
o'tgan ish uchun uzr: sorry **for shouting**

examples.title: **afraid to** do: too scared to do it
examples.description: afraid to + fe'l — qo'rqib, biror ishni ataylab qilmaslik: aytishga, so'rashga, qarshi chiqishga qo'rqmoq.

sentences.text: Madina was **afraid to tell** her parents that she had failed the exam.
sentences.translation: Madina ota-onasiga imtihondan yiqilganini **aytishga qo'rqdi**.

sentences.text: Many employees are **afraid to disagree** with the director in meetings.
sentences.translation: Ko'p xodimlar yig'ilishlarda direktorga **qarshi chiqishga qo'rqadi**.

sentences.text: Don't be **afraid to make** mistakes — that's how you learn a language.
sentences.translation: **Xato qilishdan qo'rqmang** — tilni aynan shunday o'rganasiz.

sentences.text: Bekzod was **afraid to open** the letter from the university.
sentences.translation: Bekzod universitetdan kelgan xatni **ochishga qo'rqdi**.

sentences.text: Why are you **afraid to speak** English with your British colleagues?
sentences.translation: Nega britaniyalik hamkasblaring bilan inglizcha **gaplashishga qo'rqasan**?

sentences.text: After the robbery, the old couple were **afraid to answer** the door.
sentences.translation: O'g'irlikdan keyin keksa er-xotin eshikni **ochishga qo'rqib qolishdi**.

sentences.text: I was **too afraid to look** down from the top of the TV tower.
sentences.translation: Teleminora tepasidan pastga **qarashga qo'rqdim**.

sentences.text: Patients are sometimes **afraid to ask** their doctor about side effects.
sentences.translation: Bemorlar ba'zan shifokordan nojo'ya ta'sirlar haqida **so'rashga qo'rqishadi**.

sentences.text: Nobody was **afraid to swim** in the lake until someone saw a snake.
sentences.translation: Kimdir ilon ko'rmaguncha hech kim ko'lda **cho'milishdan qo'rqmasdi**.

sentences.text: Oliver is **afraid to drive** in Tashkent because the traffic is so chaotic.
sentences.translation: Toshkentda harakat juda tartibsiz bo'lgani uchun Oliver u yerda **mashina haydashga qo'rqadi**.

examples.title: **afraid of** -ing: something bad might happen
examples.description: afraid of + -ing — biror yomon narsa (o'z ixtiyoringizdan tashqari) sodir bo'lib qolishidan qo'rqish: toyib ketish, yo'qotish, kechikish.

sentences.text: I hold the rail on the stairs because I'm **afraid of slipping**.
sentences.translation: Zinada tutqichni ushlab yuraman, chunki **toyib ketishdan qo'rqaman**.

sentences.text: Grandpa never carries much cash — he's **afraid of being** robbed.
sentences.translation: Bobom hech qachon ko'p naqd pul olib yurmaydi — **o'g'irlatib qo'yishdan qo'rqadi**.

sentences.text: We left two hours early because we were **afraid of missing** the flight.
sentences.translation: Reysga **kechikib qolishdan qo'rqib**, ikki soat oldin yo'lga chiqdik.

sentences.text: Sarah is **afraid of losing** her job if the company closes the London office.
sentences.translation: Kompaniya London ofisini yopsa, Sara **ishidan ayrilib qolishdan qo'rqadi**.

sentences.text: Are you **afraid of getting** lost in the old city?
sentences.translation: Eski shaharda **adashib qolishdan qo'rqasizmi**?

sentences.text: The little boy was **afraid of being** left alone in the dark.
sentences.translation: Kichkina bola qorong'ida **yolg'iz qolib ketishdan qo'rqardi**.

sentences.text: Many people avoid the doctor because they're **afraid of hearing** bad news.
sentences.translation: Ko'p odamlar **yomon xabar eshitishdan qo'rqib**, shifokorga bormaydi.

sentences.text: Dilnoza drives very slowly — she's **afraid of having** an accident.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza juda sekin haydaydi — **avariyaga uchrashdan qo'rqadi**.

sentences.text: Tom didn't try the street food because he was **afraid of getting** ill.
sentences.translation: Tom **kasal bo'lib qolishdan qo'rqib**, ko'chadagi taomlarni tatib ko'rmadi.

sentences.text: Nobody likes speaking first in class — everyone is **afraid of looking** silly.
sentences.translation: Hech kim darsda birinchi bo'lib gapirishni yoqtirmaydi — hamma **kulgili ko'rinib qolishdan qo'rqadi**.

examples.title: **afraid to** or **afraid of** -ing? Contrasts
examples.description: Bir gapda yoki juftlikda: afraid to — qilishga jur'at etmaslik, afraid of -ing — yomon oqibatdan qo'rqish.

sentences.text: Aziz was **afraid to jump** into the river because he was **afraid of hitting** the rocks.
sentences.translation: Aziz toshlarga **urilib ketishdan qo'rqib**, daryoga **sakrashga jur'at etmadi**.

sentences.text: Kate is **afraid to go** to the dentist; she's **afraid of feeling** pain.
sentences.translation: Keyt tish shifokoriga **borishga qo'rqadi**: **og'riq sezishdan qo'rqadi**.

sentences.text: Jasur was **afraid to say** anything because he was **afraid of upsetting** his boss.
sentences.translation: Jasur boshlig'ini **xafa qilib qo'yishdan qo'rqib**, hech narsa **deyishga botinmadi**.

sentences.text: Before the concert, the young singer was **afraid of forgetting** the words.
sentences.translation: Konsert oldidan yosh qo'shiqchi **so'zlarni unutib qo'yishdan qo'rqardi**.

sentences.text: Children shouldn't be **afraid to talk** to their parents about problems at school.
sentences.translation: Bolalar maktabdagi muammolar haqida ota-onasi bilan **gaplashishdan qo'rqmasligi** kerak.

sentences.text: She held the baby carefully because she was **afraid of dropping** him.
sentences.translation: U chaqaloqni **tushirib yuborishdan qo'rqib**, ehtiyotkorlik bilan ko'tardi.

sentences.text: Was James **afraid to try** the horse meat at the wedding?
sentences.translation: To'yda Jeyms qazini **tatib ko'rishga qo'rqdimi**?

sentences.text: Some tourists are **afraid of being** cheated, so they never use local taxis.
sentences.translation: Ba'zi sayyohlar **aldanib qolishdan qo'rqib**, mahalliy taksilarga hech qachon o'tirishmaydi.

sentences.text: Investors are **afraid to put** money into the company after the scandal.
sentences.translation: Janjaldan keyin investorlar kompaniyaga **pul tikishga qo'rqyapti**.

sentences.text: Nilufar wasn't **afraid to say** what she thought, even though she was **afraid of losing** friends.
sentences.translation: Nilufar do'stlarini **yo'qotib qo'yishdan qo'rqsa ham**, fikrini **aytishdan tortinmadi**.

examples.title: **sorry to** hear / bother / say
examples.description: sorry to + fe'l — shu ondagi holat uchun afsus yoki uzr: sorry to hear, sorry to bother you, sorry to say, sorry to keep you waiting.

sentences.text: **Sorry to bother** you, but could you help me with this printer?
sentences.translation: **Bezovta qilganim uchun uzr**, mana bu printer bilan yordam bera olasizmi?

sentences.text: We were so **sorry to hear** about your grandmother's death.
sentences.translation: Buvingizning vafotini **eshitib, juda qayg'urdik**.

sentences.text: I'm **sorry to say** that your application was unsuccessful.
sentences.translation: **Afsus bilan aytishim kerakki**, arizangiz qabul qilinmadi.

sentences.text: **Sorry to keep** you **waiting** — the traffic was terrible.
sentences.translation: Sizni **kuttirib qo'yganim uchun uzr** — tirbandlik dahshat edi.

sentences.text: Madina was **sorry to leave** Edinburgh after four wonderful years.
sentences.translation: To'rt ajoyib yildan keyin Edinburgdan **ketish** Madinaga **og'ir botdi**.

sentences.text: I'm **sorry to interrupt**, but the taxi is waiting outside.
sentences.translation: **Gapingizni bo'lganim uchun kechirasiz**, taksi tashqarida kutyapti.

sentences.text: The pupils were **sorry to say** goodbye to Mr Brown after thirty years.
sentences.translation: O'ttiz yil dars bergan janob Braun bilan **xayrlashish** o'quvchilarga **og'ir botdi**.

sentences.text: Hello, **sorry to call** so late — is Aziz still awake?
sentences.translation: Salom, **kech qo'ng'iroq qilganim uchun uzr** — Aziz hali uxlamadimi?

sentences.text: Customers will be **sorry to learn** that the café is closing in December.
sentences.translation: Mijozlar kafe dekabrda yopilishini **bilib, afsuslanishadi**.

sentences.text: Were you **sorry to leave** your old job, or were you glad to go?
sentences.translation: Eski ishingizdan **ketishga achindingizmi** yoki ketganingizdan xursand bo'ldingizmi?

examples.title: **sorry for** / **about** -ing: apologising for the past
examples.description: O'tgan ish uchun uzr: sorry for / about + -ing yoki I'm sorry I + o'tgan zamon. Kishiga achinish: feel sorry for somebody.

sentences.text: I'm **sorry for shouting** at you yesterday — I was really stressed.
sentences.translation: Kecha senga **baqirganim uchun uzr** — juda asabiy edim.

sentences.text: Tom said he was **sorry about breaking** the vase and offered to pay for it.
sentences.translation: Tom vazani **sindirgani uchun uzr so'radi** va pulini to'lashni taklif qildi.

sentences.text: **Sorry for not replying** sooner — I've been away all week.
sentences.translation: Tezroq **javob bermaganim uchun uzr** — butun hafta yo'q edim.

sentences.text: I'm **sorry I forgot** your birthday; let me take you out for dinner.
sentences.translation: Tug'ilgan kuningni **unutganim uchun kechir**; seni kechki ovqatga taklif qilay.

sentences.text: The airline was **sorry about losing** our luggage and gave us a voucher.
sentences.translation: Aviakompaniya yukimizni **yo'qotib qo'ygani uchun uzr so'radi** va bizga vaucher berdi.

sentences.text: Kate felt **sorry for** the new student, who didn't know anyone.
sentences.translation: Keyt hech kimni tanimaydigan yangi talabaga **achindi**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza is still **sorry about missing** her best friend's wedding.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza eng yaqin dugonasining to'yiga **borolmaganidan** hali ham **afsuslanadi**.

sentences.text: Are you **sorry for what you said**? — Yes, I shouldn't have said it.
sentences.translation: **Aytgan gapingdan pushaymonmisan**? — Ha, aytmasligim kerak edi.

sentences.text: We're **sorry for any inconvenience** caused by the delay.
sentences.translation: Kechikish tufayli yuzaga kelgan **noqulayliklar uchun uzr so'raymiz**.

sentences.text: Jasur wrote a long message saying how **sorry he was for lying**.
sentences.translation: Jasur **yolg'on gapirgani uchun** qanchalik **afsusdaligini** aytib, uzun xabar yozdi.

examples.title: **interested in** -ing / **interested to** hear
examples.description: interested in -ing — qiziqish yoki niyat; interested to hear / know / read / learn — ma'lumotga shu ondagi qiziqish.

sentences.text: Bekzod **is interested in starting** his own IT company.
sentences.translation: Bekzod o'z IT kompaniyasini **ochish niyatida**.

sentences.text: I'd **be interested to hear** your opinion about the new manager.
sentences.translation: Yangi menejer haqidagi fikringizni **eshitish qiziq bo'lardi**.

sentences.text: Are you **interested in coming** with us to the Navruz festival?
sentences.translation: Biz bilan Navro'z sayliga **borishni xohlaysizmi**?

sentences.text: I was **interested to read** that Samarkand is older than Rome.
sentences.translation: Samarqand Rimdan qadimiyroq ekanini **o'qib, qiziqib qoldim**.

sentences.text: Emma has never been **interested in cooking**, so she eats out a lot.
sentences.translation: Emma hech qachon **pazandalikka qiziqmagan**, shuning uchun ko'pincha tashqarida ovqatlanadi.

sentences.text: Scientists were **interested to find** that the bees preferred blue flowers.
sentences.translation: Olimlar asalarilar ko'k gullarni afzal ko'rishini **aniqlab, qiziqib qolishdi**.

sentences.text: Is anyone **interested in buying** my old bike? It's in good condition.
sentences.translation: Eski velosipedimni **sotib olishni xohlaydigan** bormi? Holati yaxshi.

sentences.text: Kate will be **interested to know** that her old school has won a prize.
sentences.translation: Eski maktabi mukofot olganini **eshitsa**, Keyt **qiziqishi aniq**.

sentences.text: Most teenagers aren't **interested in hearing** advice from adults.
sentences.translation: Ko'pchilik o'smirlar kattalarning maslahatini **tinglashni istamaydi**.

sentences.text: We'd be **interested to learn** more about your experience in Manchester.
sentences.translation: Manchesterdagi tajribangiz haqida ko'proq **bilishni istardik**.

examples.title: **sure to** / **sure of** -ing: who is sure?
examples.description: sure / certain to + fe'l — gapiruvchi amin; sure / certain of -ing — egasining o'zi amin. confident of -ing ham shunday.

sentences.text: The weather forecast is good, so the match **is sure to go** ahead.
sentences.translation: Ob-havo bashorati yaxshi, shuning uchun o'yin **albatta bo'lib o'tadi**.

sentences.text: Our team **is confident of winning** the cup this year.
sentences.translation: Jamoamiz bu yil kubokni **yutishiga ishonadi**.

sentences.text: Aziz **is sure of passing** the exam, but he hasn't studied much.
sentences.translation: Aziz imtihondan **o'tishiga amin**, lekin u ko'p o'qimagan.

sentences.text: With so many fans, the concert **is certain to sell** out.
sentences.translation: Shuncha muxlis bor ekan, konsert chiptalari **albatta sotilib ketadi**.

sentences.text: Before the election, the party **was sure of getting** most of the votes.
sentences.translation: Saylov oldidan partiya ovozlarning ko'pchiligini **olishiga amin edi**.

sentences.text: Don't lend Tom money — he's **sure to forget** to pay you back.
sentences.translation: Tomga qarz berma — u **albatta qaytarishni unutadi**.

sentences.text: Can we **be sure of finding** a hotel room without booking?
sentences.translation: Oldindan band qilmasdan mehmonxonadan **joy topishimizga ishonsa bo'ladimi**?

sentences.text: The new museum **is certain to attract** thousands of visitors.
sentences.translation: Yangi muzey **shubhasiz** minglab tashrif buyuruvchilarni **jalb qiladi**.

sentences.text: Sarah seemed very **sure of getting** the promotion, so we were surprised when she didn't.
sentences.translation: Sara **lavozimi oshishiga** juda **amin ko'rinardi**, shuning uchun bunday bo'lmaganda hayron qoldik.

sentences.text: If you take the motorway, you're **sure to arrive** before dark.
sentences.translation: Avtomagistraldan yursangiz, qorong'i tushmasdan **albatta yetib borasiz**.

examples.title: Dialogue: an apology after a difficult meeting
examples.description: Suhbat: hamkasb yig'ilishdagi qo'polligi uchun uzr so'raydi — afraid, sorry, interested va sure bir joyda.

sentences.text: — Hi Madina, **sorry to bother** you. Have you got a minute?
sentences.translation: — Salom, Madina, **bezovta qilganim uchun uzr**. Bir daqiqa vaqting bormi?

sentences.text: — Of course, Tom. What's wrong? You look **afraid to say** something.
sentences.translation: — Albatta, Tom. Nima bo'ldi? Nimadir **deyishga qo'rqayotganga** o'xshaysan.

sentences.text: — Well, I'm **sorry for being** so rude to you at the meeting.
sentences.translation: — Gap shundaki, yig'ilishda senga **qo'pollik qilganim uchun uzr so'rayman**.

sentences.text: — Thanks. Honestly, I was **afraid to talk** to you after that.
sentences.translation: — Rahmat. Rostini aytsam, o'shandan keyin sen bilan **gaplashishga qo'rqdim**.

sentences.text: — I understand. I was just **afraid of losing** the contract with the bank.
sentences.translation: — Tushunaman. Men shunchaki bank bilan shartnomani **boy berib qo'yishdan qo'rqqan edim**.

sentences.text: — Did we lose it? I was **sorry to hear** that the director was unhappy.
sentences.translation: — Uni boy berdikmi? Direktor norozi bo'lganini **eshitib, xafa bo'ldim**.

sentences.text: — No, we kept it! In fact, they're **interested in signing** a bigger deal.
sentences.translation: — Yo'q, saqlab qoldik! Aslida, ular kattaroq **shartnoma imzolashga qiziqishyapti**.

sentences.text: — That's great news! I'd be **interested to know** how you persuaded them.
sentences.translation: — Bu ajoyib yangilik! Ularni qanday ko'ndirganingni **bilish qiziq bo'lardi**.

sentences.text: — Your figures helped, actually. So I'm **sorry about blaming** you for the delay.
sentences.translation: — Aslida, sening raqamlaring yordam berdi. Shuning uchun kechikishda seni **ayblaganim uchun uzr**.

sentences.text: — Apology accepted. With a deal like that, the boss **is sure to be** happy.
sentences.translation: — Uzring qabul. Bunday shartnoma bilan boshliq **albatta xursand bo'ladi**.
